purpose: Use fresh N=100 simulations to stability-screen a pre-ranked shortlist of five matched N=10 batteries before freezing the final three whiteboxes.
shortlist_rule: Take the five lowest-score matched physical-regime triplets under the existing N=10 latency/cost/mixed role ranking. Do not use N=100 results to alter shortlist membership or ordering.

calibration.selection_use: stability gate, not precision reporting and not midpoint optimization

post_calibration_selection.battery_pass_rule: All three frozen whiteboxes must replicate their N=10 request-failure role and remain inside the frozen normalized SLA-compliance-area gate [0.50,0.75].
post_calibration_selection.winner_rule: Choose the first battery in the pre-frozen N=10 shortlist ordering that passes the battery_pass_rule. N=100 area values must not reorder passing batteries.
post_calibration_selection.if_none_pass: Stop and report protocol failure; do not tune thresholds or try additional batteries on the calibration data.

final_confirmation.use: untouched final confirmation only after the three final whiteboxes are frozen
